message.content:
方程式為  
\[
x^{2}+2x+3=0
\]

先計算判別式 \(D=b^{2}-4ac\)：  

\[
D=2^{2}-4\cdot1\cdot3=4-12=-8
\]

因為 \(D<0\)，此方程式沒有實數根，只能得到複數根。利用求根公式：

\[
x=\frac{-b\pm\sqrt{D}}{2a}
   =\frac{-2\pm\sqrt{-8}}{2}
   =\frac{-2\pm i\sqrt{8}}{2}
   =-1\pm i\sqrt{2}
\]

所以方程式的兩個解是  

\[
x_1=-1+i\sqrt{2}, \qquad x_2=-1-i\sqrt{2}
\]

The discriminant D = b^2 - 4ac = 4 - 12 = -8. So no real solutions; complex solutions: x = [-b ± sqrt(D)]/(2a) = (-2 ± sqrt(-8))/(2) = (-2 ± i*sqrt(8))/2 = (-2 ± i*2*sqrt(2))/2 = -1 ± i*sqrt(2). So the solutions are x = -1 + i√2 and x = -1 - i√2.
